name: Ambarish
meaning_en: Name of the devoted king of the Bhagavata Purana.

name: Dasharath
meaning_en: Having ten chariots; Rama's father.

name: Gudakesh
meaning_en: Conqueror of sleep; Arjuna in the Bhagavad Gita.

name: Harishchandra
meaning_en: Golden moon; the king famed for truthfulness.

name: Janak
meaning_en: Father, progenitor; the sage-king, father of Sita.

name: Kaunteya
meaning_en: Son of Kunti; Arjuna.

name: Kiriti
meaning_en: Crowned one; Arjuna, who wore Indra's diadem.

name: Kush
meaning_en: Sacred kusha grass; one of Rama's twin sons.

name: Luv
meaning_en: Name of one of Rama's twin sons.

name: Markandeya
meaning_en: Name of the sage saved from death by Shiva.

name: Nal
meaning_en: Name of the righteous king of the Nala-Damayanti story; also the vanara who built Rama's bridge.

name: Pavak
meaning_en: Fire, the purifier.

name: Raghu
meaning_en: Swift; the ancestor of Rama's dynasty.

name: Rantidev
meaning_en: Name of the generous king who gave away his last food.

name: Satyaki
meaning_en: Descendant of Satyaka; Krishna's loyal warrior friend.

name: Savyasachi
meaning_en: Ambidextrous archer; Arjuna.

name: Shatrughna
meaning_en: Slayer of enemies; Rama's youngest brother.

name: Shibi
meaning_en: Name of the king who offered his own flesh to save a dove.

name: Sugreev
meaning_en: Handsome-necked; the vanara king, Rama's ally.

name: Sushen
meaning_en: Having a fine army; the vanara physician of the Ramayana.

name: Vibhishan
meaning_en: Terrifying (to evil); Ravana's righteous brother, devotee of Rama.

name: Yogeshwar
meaning_en: Lord of yoga; Krishna.
